profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer / Manager at SPR
profile.summary:
For the last 10 years I have been active in law enforcement, with prior experience in the Marines. I have recently exited my career in law enforcement to pursue my true passion. I knew a career in computer science was always where I wanted to be. I completed courses toward a computer science degree, yet knew I needed an edge. I attended Fullstack Academy of Code to bridge the gap. I am grateful for this opportunity to switch to software development. I am looking forward to growing and developing myself into this new role. By constantly challenging myself in this new field, I know my prior experience from past roles bring the ability to handle high stress and overcoming obstacles will be an asset in this new field.


PROFICIENT:
Javascript, C++, React, Redux, Node, SSR, Next.js, Express, REST, Sequelize ORM, PostgreSQL, Mocha, Chai, Jest, Enzyme, HTML5, CSS3, Agile, Waffle.io
FAMILIAR:
React Native, JQuery, SQL, C#, JAVA, Unity, Heroku, Webpack, Xamarin, Swift, PWA, ARKit, Vuforia 


GitHub: https://github.com/ShaneECDavis

positions.title: Sergeant
positions.description: Supervises Deputies, Attended multiple leadership trainings schools, Critical thinking to determine how to manage inmates in overcrowded jail, Patrol Supervisor Training, Field Training Officer

positions.title: PSYOP
positions.description:
Researched and analyze methods of influencing from a variety of information sources
Conducted operations ranging from strategic planning down to tactical deployment
Coordinated resources requirements for the development, production and dissemination of PSYOP productions
Contributed in the integration of psychological operations planning in support of conventional, special operations and deception planning
Assisted in determining the appropriate mix of media, relative to available assets, to disseminate PSYOP products
Additional Training:
   Psychological Operations Specialist (37f)
   Warriors Leaders Course
   Air Assault
